title: Compute focal domain curvature energies
action: Implement the geometric description of Dupin cyclides for a normal focal domain (ellipse + hyperbola) and a parabolic focal domain. For the normal domain, set up the energy double integral over parameters u, v, integrate over r analytically or numerically, and evaluate for semi-major axis a=1, eccentricity e=0.5, core radius r_c=0.01, with elastic constant K1=1. For the parabolic domain, set up the energy integral over α₁, α₂, integrate over r, introduce a cylindrical cut-off radius R=2, focal length f=1, core radius r_c=0.01, and evaluate with K1=1. Write the computed energies W_n, W_p and a boolean indicating whether the parabolic domain has lower energy to focal_domain_energies.json.
description: Output containing the curvature energies W_n (normal focal domain) and W_p (parabolic focal domain of the first species) and a boolean flag indicating whether the parabolic domain is favoured (W_p < W_n). All energies are in units of K1·length with K1=1.
